text: {"name":"wlc_radio_monitor","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Polls radio-related hardware and software status, then schedules or advances the WLC radio-state transition for the input context.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v1":"radio_state_ctx","v3":"hardware_status","v4":"radio_status_ok"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Input context flags; bit 1 is cleared"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"Input context activity or enable byte checked for nonzero"},{"offset":149,"meaning":"Input context mode byte selecting the immediate transition path"},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Radio-state context pointer to the current input context"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Radio-state context flag gating the chip-state update"},{"offset":29,"meaning":"Radio-monitor state byte"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Radio-state context flag gating the scheduled transition"}]}
